title: flt.speaker~
description: `flt.speaker~` is a band-pass filter that emulates a speaker response, with a low-frequency +12 dB/octave slope implemented by two DC blockers in series and a high-frequency −24 dB/octave slope. Its two creation arguments set the lower and upper band frequencies in hertz: F1 ranges from 20 to 1000 Hz, while F2 ranges from 1000 to 20000 Hz.
